subject: Taproot deal — provisional GPU sizing check & hold request
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Taproot sizing: request to validate GPU pool & propose provisional hold

Team —

Late-stage Taproot deal (TPR-2026-049) is asking us to hold capacity while procurement finalizes the PO. They are targeting a mid-November pilot and want peak inference capacity for a production pilot (estimated sustained throughput: ~120k tokens/min, 40 concurrent sessions with 2–3s tail latency SLO).

Can infra confirm the following by EOD:
- Available GPU mix (H100 / A100-80GB / L4 equiv) in us-west region for a 30-day soft hold starting 2026-11-01.
- Rough cost/QPS estimate and any recommended model sizing (e.g., 8xA100 vs 6xH100) for the pilot.
- Any constraints that would block a provisional hold (other commitments, maintenance windows).

Attaching Taproot requirements doc (taproot_requirements_v1.pdf). If we can place a soft hold pending PO (7–14 day buffer after PO), please include the hold window and the inventory IDs we would reserve.

Grace
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0192

Attachments: taproot_requirements_v1.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Taproot sizing: request to validate GPU pool & propose provisional hold

Grace —

Quick inventory check and recommendation (us-west cluster):
- Available at short notice (capacity not currently committed):
  • 6 x H100 80GB (SXM) — ideal for latency-heavy runs and larger context (recommended for primary serving)
  • 12 x A100 80GB (PCIe) — good for batchy or mixed workloads, cheaper throughput for non-latency-critical shards
  • 10 x L4 (short-term warm spare) — cost-efficient for lightweight embedding/aux tasks

Sizing suggestion for Taproot pilot (based on their numbers):
- Primary serving: 6 x H100 (pinned), configured with model sharding to support 40 concurrent sessions and 1–3s P95.
- Overflow/burst: 8 x A100 added to the pool for autoscaling burst to preserve SLOs during traffic spikes.
- Expected steady token throughput fit: ~100–140k tokens/min with headroom for 20% surge.

Soft-hold feasibility:
- We can place a provisional soft-hold for the window 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 on the following inventory IDs: H100-SXM-usw-07..12 and A100-PCE-usw-21..28.
- Caveat: we have a scheduled capacity refresh on 2026-11-16 in us-west; soft-hold can coexist but would become binding only after final firmware validation (we can shuffle reservations if required).

Costs (rough internal estimate):
- 6x H100 reserved (pilot month): ~$110k (rack + infra overhead)
- 8x A100 burst standby (monthly equivalent amortized): ~$45k

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sales ops (Monica) sign provisional_hold_form_TPR-2026-049.pdf and approve a 14-day soft-hold window (we set an auto-release if PO not received by 2026-11-15).
2) If approved, infra will mark the inventory IDs as held and generate a hold ticket stub for legal/proc.

I've attached a snapshot: gpu_inventory_snapshot-20261028.csv and provisional_hold_form_TPR-2026-049.pdf.

- Dylan
Director, Infra Capacity Planning

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot-20261028.csv, provisional_hold_form_TPR-2026-049.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@taproot.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Taproot pilot sizing — confirmation and next steps

Oliver —

Thanks for the quick convo earlier. Per the infra team's inventory check (below), we can provisionally hold capacity in us-west to support a mid-Nov pilot. Two asks to keep momentum:
1) Can you confirm final expected peak concurrent sessions and a firm target go-live date for the pilot? (Dylan used 40 concurrent in his sizing — confirm if we should size up.)
2) Procurement: will Taproot be able to issue a PO within ~10 business days? If not, let us know preferred hold extension and whether a refundable deposit is an option.

I'm copying infra and sales ops to coordinate the provisional hold once we get your confirmation.

Link: Mutual action plan — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/TPR-2026-049

Grace

Subject: Re: Taproot pilot sizing — confirmation and next steps

Grace / team —

Thanks — confirmed numbers look right for our pilot. Final details:
- Peak concurrent sessions: 45 (we've added buffer for internal QA).
- Target pilot go-live: 2026-11-15 (we may have a soft ramp from 11/15–11/22).
- Procurement timeline: procurement expects to issue PO within 10 business days (target PO date 2026-11-12).
- Request: Taproot would like a 14-day provisional hold starting 2026-11-01 to ensure we can lock capacity while contracts finalize. If you need a deposit, we can arrange it — please send an invoice stub.

Oliver Grant
Head of Platform — Taproot.ai
oliver@taproot.ai | +1-206-555-0114
